parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional (ADR 0006): 1-128 printable ASCII characters, a client-generated UUID per logical request (a retry reuses it). Without it the request runs unkeyed. A repeated key with the same method, path and body returns the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true: a 2xx, or a final refusal (bad-request, idempotency-key-invalid, robot-not-found, asrs-not-found, unknown-port, wrong-port-kind, invalid-position, unknown-fault-kind). A retryable refusal (port-occupied, position-occupied, asrs-rejected, command-not-applied) is not stored and its key is released, so the retry executes again. With a different method, path or body under a stored answer it is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A 5xx is never stored. A malformed key is 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Answers are kept 24 hours in process memory and are lost on a restart (single replica).
